description: Scanner configuration — change the provider to switch data sources. The scanner module reads this file to know which provider to use.

credit_tracking.description: Track API credits to stay within daily limits. Spend MORE credits during high-liquidity hours, LESS overnight.

overnight_low_liquidity.why: Low liquidity — forex and crypto only, stocks closed, prices move slowly

schedule.priority_assets: ETH, Gold, USDJPY (assets near trigger) — every 15 min = 3 credits × 12 = 36

pre_london.why: Medium liquidity — preparing for London open, check overnight results

schedule.pre_market_gaps: Check Finviz (FREE) + quote top 5 gappers = 5 credits

london_session.why: High liquidity — London forex + commodities active

schedule.london_open_scan: Full London + resource watchlist (25 assets) = 25 credits

ny_session.why: HIGHEST liquidity — NY + London overlap, ALL markets active, most opportunities

crypto_session.why: High liquidity — crypto session peak + late NY

credit_tracking.near_trigger_rule: If an asset is within 1% of TP/SL/limit fill → scan every 15 min regardless of session. If within 0.5% → scan every 5 min.
credit_tracking.fallback: If credits exhausted → switch to TradingView quotes (free, unlimited but slow)
credit_tracking.exceptions: Major overnight events (geopolitical, BOJ, emergency) → override budget and scan more

twelve-data.name: Twelve Data
twelve-data.limitations: WTI/USD requires Grow plan. Free tier: 800 API credits/day.

polygon.name: Polygon.io
polygon.limitations: No direct commodities (XAUUSD, WTI). Use ETFs instead (GLD, USO).
polygon.note: Not implemented yet — switch active_provider to 'polygon' and create providers/polygon.js

alpha-vantage.name: Alpha Vantage
alpha-vantage.limitations: Slow. 5 calls/min free. 15 min delay on free tier.

symbol_mapping.description: Maps our internal symbols to provider-specific formats. Each provider may use different symbol formats.
